entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Romus, over here!""
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, over here!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was attending to paperwork in my..."
entries.dialogueText: I was attending to paperwork in my study when I received the grim call.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother had fallen ill on a visit..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother had fallen ill on a visit to Monqiz. She was in a medical suite at the royal hospital there.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I immediately asked for the helicop..."
entries.dialogueText: I immediately asked for the helicopter to be prepared. In a few moments, we were in the air.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I feared for the worst as we landed..."
entries.dialogueText: I feared for the worst as we landed on the helipad on top of the hospital. I rushed downstairs and approached the door to the suite.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I opened the door."
entries.dialogueText: I opened the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room was empty. A nurse approac..."
entries.dialogueText: The room was empty. A nurse approached us and bowed before me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is the meaning of this?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is the meaning of this?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where is my mother?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where is my mother?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is Madam Estela okay?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is Madam Estela okay?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The nurse explained to me that she..."
entries.dialogueText: The nurse explained to me that she was taking the air outside in the gazebo.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I rushed to the gazebo in the hospi..."
entries.dialogueText: I rushed to the gazebo in the hospital gardens.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I left the building immediately."
entries.dialogueText: I left the building immediately.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There she was, standing and waving..."
entries.dialogueText: There she was, standing and waving at me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mother. Would you care to tell me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mother. Would you care to tell me why I'm here?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked up to her. She seemed perf..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked up to her. She seemed perfectly healthy.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's happened to you? I came as..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's happened to you? I came as soon as I got the call."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your recovery's proceeding nicely,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your recovery's proceeding nicely, I see."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You'd better really be sick. Other..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'd better really be sick. Otherwise, you're just wasting my time."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Because you're a good son who trus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because you're a good son who trusts his mother, even when she feigns an illness to lure him out to Monqiz."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Time is of the essence. Come on. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Time is of the essence. Come on. I'll tell you everything on the way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sighed deeply."
entries.dialogueText: She sighed deeply.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On the way to where?""
entries.dialogueText: "On the way to where?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You'll tell me now, or I won't go..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll tell me now, or I won't go anywhere."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Explain yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Explain yourself."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I know how stubborn you male Toras..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know how stubborn you male Torases are. But now that I have your attention, I need you to take me seriously."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Listen. Don't ask me how I got thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen. Don't ask me how I got this information, but there's a coup attempt in the works."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But we're getting out of here. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we're getting out of here. The day I let anything bad happen to my only son is the day the sea worms eat my bones."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Come now. The boat is waiting. I'v..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come now. The boat is waiting. I've handled everything. Your luggage is loaded and departure is imminent."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about Vina?""
entries.dialogueText: "What about Vina?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about Hugo?""
entries.dialogueText: "What about Hugo?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where is the boat going?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where is the boat going?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is this threat really so monstrous..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is this threat really so monstrous that we need to leave the country?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're asking me to run away from..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're asking me to run away from my country instead of facing my problems head-on. Like a coward."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But how will we even live? Are we..."
entries.dialogueText: "But how will we even live? Are we going to have to actually work?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela

entries.dialogueText: "It's right by the beach. Sun, sand and lots of cocktails await."

entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, your uncle's always been able..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, your uncle's always been able to fend for himself in these situations."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""He and his brute of a son will be..."
entries.dialogueText: "He and his brute of a son will be just fine."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A mother knows. I have eyes everyw..."
entries.dialogueText: "A mother knows. I have eyes everywhere. Inside the palace and out."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I can smell danger, and trust me,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can smell danger, and trust me, right now what I'm smelling is one big garbage fire."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""She's on the boat, waiting for us.""
entries.dialogueText: "She's on the boat, waiting for us."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Thank Dast she came to her dear ol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank Dast she came to her dear old grandma's aid."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother sighed and clutched her f..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother sighed and clutched her forehead.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That damn girl is still nowhere to..."
entries.dialogueText: "That damn girl is still nowhere to be found."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I had such high hopes for her. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had such high hopes for her. But I'm sure that wherever she is now, she's safer than she would be in Rizia."

entries.dialogueText: "You... what? What do you mean you won't leave?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela

entries.dialogueText: "Did you not hear the part where I told you your life was in danger?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I am not a coward."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I have to find another way out of this."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela

entries.dialogueText: "Who cares about responsibilities?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Romus, don't you get it? You might..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, don't you get it? You might die!"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela

entries.dialogueText: "You can't. Not without risking your hide."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Her voice was trembling. She started to tear up.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It's only for a short while.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's only for a short while."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Please, Romus. Please.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Romus. Please."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You're the only family I have left.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're the only family I have left."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When you put it that way... fine...."
entries.dialogueText: "When you put it that way... fine. Let's get going."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.title: Estela Toras: ""What I'd like is for our family to..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That's exactly what your father to..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Ah. That. Sorry, darling. I didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah. That. Sorry, darling. I didn't mean to worry you."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Believe it or not, we have been in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Believe it or not, we have been invited to the royal court of Queen Beatrice."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Say what you will about that woman..."
entries.dialogueText: "Say what you will about that woman -- and I've said plenty. But when her in-laws' lives are on the line, she delivers."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I did warn you not to go splashing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did warn you not to go splashing your relationship all over the Rizian news. But now that you're about to be ousted, it hardly matters."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're my security councilor! Why..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She patted her heavily distended be..."
entries.dialogueText: She patted her heavily distended belly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why the hell didn't your father wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why the hell didn't your father warn me about this?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I admit, dear, I half-expected you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I admit, dear, I half-expected you to  attempt to get rid of me yourself."

entries.dialogueText: "He was new to the Council. Perhaps he was still getting accustomed to his position when..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shuddered."
entries.dialogueText: She shuddered.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But whoever is behind this took de..."
entries.dialogueText: "But whoever is behind this took deep pains to hide their activities from the Azaros. They knew we were in league with the Crown."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I know, and I'm sorry. My... condi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know, and I'm sorry. My... condition must have dulled my instincts."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He's made of sturdy stuff. Just li..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's made of sturdy stuff. Just like his mother."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It won't be easy growing up as a p..."
entries.dialogueText: "It won't be easy growing up as a prince in exile. But he'll have his parents with him."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled at me."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled at me.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And when he's all grown up, he'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "And when he's all grown up, he'll come back to Rizia and take what's his."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And it might not be long before we..."
entries.dialogueText: "And it might not be long before we all return home and take what's ours."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She let out a long, loud laugh."
entries.dialogueText: She let out a long, loud laugh.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Don't be silly. If I wanted you go..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be silly. If I wanted you gone, you'd be gone."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Besides, we can't have {RiziaDLCTe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Besides, we can't have {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon} growing up without a father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't believe Lucita Azaro would..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe Lucita Azaro would leave Rizia without a fight."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A less pregnant me would've stuck..."
entries.dialogueText: "A less pregnant me would've stuck around and fought. But I can't risk it now."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It feels like just yesterday we we..."
entries.dialogueText: "It feels like just yesterday we were celebrating our triumph over Pales. All for nothing..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""All that bloodshed in Pales, just..."
entries.dialogueText: "All that bloodshed in Pales, just to wind up as exiles..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But it could be worse.""
entries.dialogueText: "But it could be worse."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Everything we've been through over..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything we've been through over the last eight years, just to wind up as exiles..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's the spirit, love.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's the spirit, love."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A fresh start, a fresh family. I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "A fresh start, a fresh family. I'm looking forward to this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How could it be worse! I've lost e..."
entries.dialogueText: "How could it be worse! I've lost everything!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She put my hand on her stomach. I f..."
entries.dialogueText: She put my hand on her stomach. I felt the thud of a little foot kicking against it.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""No, you haven't.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, you haven't."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Whatever's waiting for us when thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever's waiting for us when this boat docks, we'll handle it together."

entries.dialogueText: "Strong already. He'll do well in basic training."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll be back shortly. Don't go any..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be back shortly. Don't go anywhere."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She grinned."
entries.dialogueText: She grinned.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Not without you, King Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not without you, King Romus."

entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel was in the wine cellar, readi..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel was in the wine cellar, reading the labels on the bottles.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pour me a glass, will you?""
entries.dialogueText: "Pour me a glass, will you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Anything good in there?""
entries.dialogueText: "Anything good in there?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But a new life was waiting for me."
entries.dialogueText: But a new life was waiting for me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What did my mother tell you?""
entries.dialogueText: "What did my mother tell you?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""If the rumors about Valenqiris' in..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the rumors about Valenqiris' involvement in the coup are true, we'd best avoid the Cantuavo."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""A few decent Cantuavos.""
entries.dialogueText: "A few decent Cantuavos."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Given the circumstances, I had bet..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given the circumstances, I had better train my palate to get used to Rumburgian whites."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now that I've got nothing to lose,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that I've got nothing to lose, we can finally be together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My mother was right. Rizia wasn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "My mother was right. Rizia wasn't ready for us."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""They're not particularly tolerant..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're not particularly tolerant of my kind over in Rumburg. But I'll make do."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Kyrute's rather more accepting of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Kyrute's rather more accepting of my kind than Rizia ever was. Of course, it's no Derdia."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Of course. I was as shocked by the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. I was as shocked by the whole affair as you were."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Two Toras monarchs, two plots to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Two Toras monarchs, two plots to get rid of them. I'm glad you survived this one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Now that I'm no longer King, I can finally do the one thing I've been wanting to do forever."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: "All right. I don't need to know any more."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela

entries.dialogueText: "The kingdom is big enough for us to fly under the radar. And we'll get to keep the lavish lifestyles to which we are so accustomed."

entries.dialogueText: "I have to go now. But let's talk more later."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to be left alone for a minute, anyway."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "Then I heard that my own husband's family might be trying to overthrow us..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela

entries.dialogueText: "And wouldn't you know it? In the end, he was right."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But if confronting it is the only..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if confronting it is the only way to keep us together, I'll settle for that."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""My king for how much longer, darli..."
entries.dialogueText: "My king for how much longer, darling?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about Bruno? Where's my dog?""
entries.dialogueText: "What about Bruno? Where's my dog?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm so sorry, dear, but I had to l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm so sorry, dear, but I had to leave him at the palace. Why would the Queen Mother bring the King's mutt to Monqiz? It would've raised too many questions."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm sure he'll be taken good care..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure he'll be taken good care of over there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am not leaving without my dog.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am not leaving without my dog."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""We'll send for the damn dog! Won't..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll send for the damn dog! Won't you listen to reason?!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where is your fiance?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where is your fiance?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Don't be foolish, son. I brought y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be foolish, son. I brought you here to save your life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This again? If you'll recall, I ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "This again? If you'll recall, I made my attitude towards traitors very clear on your birthday."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Never a dull moment for us royals,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never a dull moment for us royals, is there?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My uncle is out of the picture. Wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "My uncle is out of the picture. Who else could possibly replace me on the throne?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This must be Hugo's doing. Who els..."
entries.dialogueText: "This must be Hugo's doing. Who else could possibly replace me on the throne?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This again? Trust me, the danger i..."
entries.dialogueText: "This again? Trust me, the danger is exaggerated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry, but I do have to ask. Where..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, but I do have to ask. Where did you get this information?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Haven't I told you already? A cup..."
entries.dialogueText: "Haven't I told you already? A cup of tea with a viscount's wife is more effective than a dozen intelligence agents. Cheaper, too."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""So you were warned before? And you..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you were warned before? And you didn't tell your dear old mother?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It seems someone didn't get the me..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems someone didn't get the message."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The guillotine waiting for us in P..."
entries.dialogueText: "The guillotine waiting for us in Porte Drazon is anything but dull."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I doubt poor Hugo would've moved a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I doubt poor Hugo would've moved a muscle against you. But there are others..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I always did have a bad feeling ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always did have a bad feeling about that man."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Believe me, there are others.""
entries.dialogueText: "Believe me, there are others."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough of your melodrama, Mother...."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough of your melodrama, Mother. I'm going home now."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Darling. Just wait a second.""
entries.dialogueText: "Darling. Just wait a second."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""If my intuition is right, this goe..."
entries.dialogueText: "If my intuition is right, this goes deeper than either of us know. We can't trust anyone back at the palace."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""He and the other Torases will be j..."
entries.dialogueText: "He and the other Torases will be just fine."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You neutered his house, remember?..."
entries.dialogueText: "You neutered his house, remember? He's not the target. We are."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I knocked on the door. No answer ca..."
entries.dialogueText: I knocked on the door. No answer came.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina, sweetheart, open up.""
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, sweetheart, open up."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We're going to be stuck together o..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're going to be stuck together on this boat for the next few days. You'll have to talk to me sooner or later."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They're trying to kill us, Vina. Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're trying to kill us, Vina. Your petty inheritance grievances don't matter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Take all the time you need. I'll b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take all the time you need. I'll be around."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The door stayed closed."
entries.dialogueText: The door stayed closed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The door stayed closed. I stepped a..."
entries.dialogueText: The door stayed closed. I stepped away from it.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've heard the rumors too, and I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard the rumors too, and I'm as worried as you are."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry I didn't heed your warni..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry I didn't heed your warnings any sooner."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I admit I'm hurt that you'd listen..."
entries.dialogueText: "I admit I'm hurt that you'd listen to your mother and not me."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But I'm just glad that you came to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I'm just glad that you came to your senses in time."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""The Sazons may outwardly tolerate..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Sazons may outwardly tolerate homosexuality, but they'll be under a lot of pressure to reinstate the old laws."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
